# Architecture Document Rules
- Component diagrams must use Mermaid syntax (```mermaid graph TD```).
- Every component listed in the diagram must have a prose description.
- Data-flow diagrams use Mermaid sequenceDiagram.
- Technology decisions must reference at least one NFR from requirements.md.
- Security boundaries must be explicitly labelled in diagrams.
